full_text:
Needle arrow

Internal ID: ArrowNeedle | Type: Arrow | Source: Workbench | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Needle x4, Feathers x2

Introduction. Needle arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from obsidian arrows.

Availability. • It is unlocked after acquiring a needle and is crafted in the workbench.
